hypothesis: A direct single-shot prompt port from EXP-000 should establish a working baseline on-device, because it replicates a known configuration and gives us a quality floor to beat.
technique: A single greedy on-device model call with no retrieval, expansion, or post-processing — a plain one-shot prompt producing 7 questions directly.
result: Scored 0.307 on dev-10 (0 wins / 1 tie / 9 losses vs Sonnet), with specPass 100% but rubric dimensions atomicity=5, spec=3, coverage=3, naturalness=3, non-redundancy=3 — coverage and spec are the clear gaps. Kept as the new best and quality floor.
label: baseline
